import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
from datetime import datetime

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Feature engineering function with improved features
def add_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Convert pickup_datetime to datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])

    # Extract datetime features
    df["pickup_hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["pickup_day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["pickup_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["pickup_weekday"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["pickup_year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year

    # Weekend indicator
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["pickup_weekday"] >= 5).astype(int)

    # Rush hour indicator (7-9 AM and 5-7 PM)
    df["is_rush_hour"] = (
        (df["pickup_hour"] >= 7) & (df["pickup_hour"] <= 9)
        | (df["pickup_hour"] >= 17) & (df["pickup_hour"] <= 19)
    ).astype(int)

    # Peak hour indicator (6 AM - 10 PM)
    df["is_peak_hour"] = ((df["pickup_hour"] >= 6) & (df["pickup_hour"] <= 22)).astype(
        int
    )

    # Cyclical encoding for temporal features
    df["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["pickup_hour"] / 24)
    df["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["pickup_hour"] / 24)
    df["month_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["pickup_month"] / 12)
    df["month_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["pickup_month"] / 12)
    df["weekday_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["pickup_weekday"] / 7)
    df["weekday_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["pickup_weekday"] / 7)

    # Calculate Haversine distance
    def haversine_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        R = 3959  # Earth radius in miles
        lat1_rad, lon1_rad = np.radians(lat1), np.radians(lon1)
        lat2_rad, lon2_rad = np.radians(lat2), np.radians(lon2)
        dlat = lat2_rad - lat1_rad
        dlon = lon2_rad - lon1_rad
        a = (
            np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2
            + np.cos(lat1_rad) * np.cos(lat2_rad) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
        )
        c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
        return R * c

    df["distance"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

    # Calculate bearing/angle between pickup and dropoff
    def calculate_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        lat1_rad, lon1_rad = np.radians(lat1), np.radians(lon1)
        lat2_rad, lon2_rad = np.radians(lat2), np.radians(lon2)
        dlon = lon2_rad - lon1_rad
        x = np.sin(dlon) * np.cos(lat2_rad)
        y = np.cos(lat1_rad) * np.sin(lat2_rad) - np.sin(lat1_rad) * np.cos(
            lat2_rad
        ) * np.cos(dlon)
        bearing = np.arctan2(x, y)
        bearing_deg = np.degrees(bearing)
        return (bearing_deg + 360) % 360

    df["bearing"] = calculate_bearing(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

    # Distance to JFK Airport (40.6413, -73.7781)
    JKF_LAT, JFK_LON = 40.6413, -73.7781
    df["dist_to_jfk"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], JKF_LAT, JFK_LON
    )
    df["dist_to_jfk_dropoff"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], JKF_LAT, JFK_LON
    )

    # Distance to LaGuardia Airport (40.7769, -73.8740)
    LGA_LAT, LGA_LON = 40.7769, -73.8740
    df["dist_to_lga"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], LGA_LAT, LGA_LON
    )
    df["dist_to_lga_dropoff"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], LGA_LAT, LGA_LON
    )

    # Distance to Manhattan center (40.7589, -73.9851)
    MAN_LAT, MAN_LON = 40.7589, -73.9851
    df["dist_to_manhattan"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], MAN_LAT, MAN_LON
    )
    df["dist_to_manhattan_dropoff"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], MAN_LAT, MAN_LON
    )

    # Distance to Central Park (40.7829, -73.9654)
    CP_LAT, CP_LON = 40.7829, -73.9654
    df["dist_to_central_park"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], CP_LAT, CP_LON
    )
    df["dist_to_central_park_dropoff"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], CP_LAT, CP_LON
    )

    # Distance to Penn Station (40.7505, -73.9934)
    PENN_LAT, PENN_LON = 40.7505, -73.9934
    df["dist_to_penn_station"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], PENN_LAT, PENN_LON
    )
    df["dist_to_penn_station_dropoff"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], PENN_LAT, PENN_LON
    )

    # Distance to Brooklyn Bridge (40.7061, -73.9969)
    BB_LAT, BB_LON = 40.7061, -73.9969
    df["dist_to_brooklyn_bridge"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], BB_LAT, BB_LON
    )
    df["dist_to_brooklyn_bridge_dropoff"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], BB_LAT, BB_LON
    )

    # Location grid binning (coarse NYC neighborhoods)
    df["pickup_lat_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["pickup_latitude"], bins=[40.5, 40.7, 40.9, 41.0], labels=[0, 1, 2]
    ).astype(float)
    df["pickup_lon_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["pickup_longitude"], bins=[-74.2, -74.0, -73.8, -73.7], labels=[0, 1, 2]
    ).astype(float)
    df["dropoff_lat_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], bins=[40.5, 40.7, 40.9, 41.0], labels=[0, 1, 2]
    ).astype(float)
    df["dropoff_lon_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["dropoff_longitude"], bins=[-74.2, -74.0, -73.8, -73.7], labels=[0, 1, 2]
    ).astype(float)

    # Interaction features
    df["distance_x_hour"] = df["distance"] * df["pickup_hour"]
    df["distance_x_weekend"] = df["distance"] * df["is_weekend"]
    df["distance_x_rush_hour"] = df["distance"] * df["is_rush_hour"]
    df["pickup_lat_x_pickup_lon"] = df["pickup_latitude"] * df["pickup_longitude"]
    df["dropoff_lat_x_dropoff_lon"] = df["dropoff_latitude"] * df["dropoff_longitude"]

    # Interaction with bearing
    df["distance_x_bearing"] = df["distance"] * np.sin(np.radians(df["bearing"]))
    df["distance_x_manhattan"] = df["distance"] * df["dist_to_manhattan"]

    # Interaction features with cyclical temporal features
    df["distance_x_hour_sin"] = df["distance"] * df["hour_sin"]
    df["distance_x_hour_cos"] = df["distance"] * df["hour_cos"]
    df["distance_x_weekday_sin"] = df["distance"] * df["weekday_sin"]
    df["distance_x_weekday_cos"] = df["distance"] * df["weekday_cos"]

    # NEW: Fare per mile ratio (for outlier detection)
    df["fare_per_mile"] = df["fare_amount"] / (df["distance"] + 0.001)

    return df


# Add features to train and test
print("Adding features...")
train_df = add_features(train_df)
test_df = add_features(test_df)

# Filter outliers for training data - IMPROVED with fare-per-mile validation
print("Filtering outliers...")

# Basic coordinate bounds (tighter NYC bounds)
coord_mask = (
    (train_df["pickup_latitude"] >= 40.5)
    & (train_df["pickup_latitude"] <= 41.0)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] >= -74.2)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] <= -73.7)
    & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] >= 40.5)
    & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] <= 41.0)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] >= -74.2)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] <= -73.7)
)

# Fare and passenger count validation
fare_mask = (
    (train_df["fare_amount"] > 0)
    & (train_df["fare_amount"] < 500)
    & (train_df["passenger_count"] > 0)
    & (train_df["passenger_count"] <= 6)
)

# NEW: Distance validation (trips should be at least 0.1 miles and at most 50 miles)
distance_mask = (train_df["distance"] > 0.1) & (train_df["distance"] < 50)

# NEW: Fare per mile ratio validation (reasonable NYC taxi rates)
# NYC taxi base rate is around $2.50 + $2.50/mile, so reasonable range is $2-$15/mile
fare_per_mile_mask = (train_df["fare_per_mile"] >= 1.5) & (
    train_df["fare_per_mile"] <= 20
)

# Apply all filters
train_df = train_df[coord_mask & fare_mask & distance_mask & fare_per_mile_mask]

print(f"Training data after filtering: {len(train_df)} rows")

# Define features to use
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "distance",
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_day",
    "pickup_month",
    "pickup_weekday",
    "pickup_year",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_rush_hour",
    "is_peak_hour",
    "pickup_lat_bin",
    "pickup_lon_bin",
    "dropoff_lat_bin",
    "dropoff_lon_bin",
    "distance_x_hour",
    "distance_x_weekend",
    "distance_x_rush_hour",
    "pickup_lat_x_pickup_lon",
    "dropoff_lat_x_dropoff_lon",
    "bearing",
    "dist_to_jfk",
    "dist_to_jfk_dropoff",
    "dist_to_lga",
    "dist_to_lga_dropoff",
    "dist_to_manhattan",
    "dist_to_manhattan_dropoff",
    "distance_x_bearing",
    "distance_x_manhattan",
    "hour_sin",
    "hour_cos",
    "month_sin",
    "month_cos",
    "weekday_sin",
    "weekday_cos",
    "dist_to_central_park",
    "dist_to_central_park_dropoff",
    "dist_to_penn_station",
    "dist_to_penn_station_dropoff",
    "dist_to_brooklyn_bridge",
    "dist_to_brooklyn_bridge_dropoff",
    "distance_x_hour_sin",
    "distance_x_hour_cos",
    "distance_x_weekday_sin",
    "distance_x_weekday_cos",
]

# Split into train and validation
print("Splitting data...")
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["fare_amount"].values

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

print(f"Training set: {len(X_train)}, Validation set: {len(X_val)}")

# Train LightGBM model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Make predictions on test set
print("Making predictions on test set...")
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_pred})

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Test predictions shape: {submission.shape}")

# Print final validation RMSE
print(f"\nFinal Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")
